# Data Source: auth0_portal

Data source to retrieve a specific Universal Portal by `id`. (EA only)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An Auth0 Universal Portal can be retrieved by its ID.
data "auth0_portal" "my_portal" {
  id = "up_XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the portal.

### Read-Only

- `client` (List of Object) The client used by the portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--client))
- `created_at` (String) The date and time when the portal was created.
- `custom_code` (List of Object) Custom code for the portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_code))
- `name` (String) The name of the portal.
- `navigation` (List of Object) Navigation for the portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--navigation))
- `pages` (List of Object) Pages of the portal. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--pages))
- `slug` (String) The unique slug of the portal.
- `updated_at` (String) The date and time when the portal was last updated.
